editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: ruvnet/ruflo
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, ruflo is an agent infrastructure designed to coordinate autonomous workflows and create multiplayer artificial intelligence swarms. The system offers adaptive memory, self-learning capability, and vector-based RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) integration that allows data to be retrieved from up-to-date sources.

snapshot.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

items.title: lightseekorg/tokenspeed
items.summary: lightseekorg/tokenspeed is a high-performance inference engine developed for large language models (LLM). Written in Python, this project aims to accelerate the prediction processes of artificial intelligence models.

snapshot.description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: Developed in the Rust language, xerj offers an auto-indexing capability that allows artificial intelligence systems to search through data. By processing code, documents, and log files with lower token consumption, it supports search, security audits, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) processes that enable AI to generate answers from up-to-date data.

snapshot.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.

items.title: LibreSpark/LibreTV
items.summary: LibreSpark/LibreTV is a TypeScript-based software project that allows you to set up a movie and TV series site in under a minute using methods like Docker. It provides an infrastructure that enables users to quickly create their own content platforms.

snapshot.description: 一分钟搭建影视站，支持Docker等部署方式

items.title: Muse Spark Open
items.summary: Muse Spark Open, released by Meta, stands out as an open-source artificial intelligence model aimed at researchers and developers. Accessible via Hugging Face, this model aims to make large-scale language processing capabilities more accessible.

items.title: Neural networks are clean
items.summary: Neural networks are clean is a project that aims to visualize the internal working principles and conceptual structures of artificial intelligence models. This platform presents how complex neural networks make decisions based on specific data in an understandable way.

items.title: Wayland desktop for Linux with skeuomorphic design
items.summary: Developed for Linux, DEsk is a desktop environment that runs on the Wayland display server and features a skeuomorphic design based on realistic object appearances. The project aims to revive traditional interface aesthetics on modern Linux systems.

items.title: What I self-host
items.summary: What I self-host is an experience-sharing project about hosting personal data and digital services on individual servers instead of third-party platforms. It covers how a user manages their own infrastructure to achieve digital independence and the software tools they prefer.

items.title: Jev meets the Trolley Problem
items.summary: Jev combines artificial intelligence decision-making mechanisms with the Trolley Problem, a classic thought experiment that examines ethical dilemmas. This study questions how autonomous systems behave when faced with moral choices.

items.title: fishaudio/drama-3
items.summary: fishaudio/drama-3, shared on Hugging Face, is a text-to-speech model that converts text into speech. It provides technology that allows users to turn written content into audio output.

items.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
items.summary: FDE-Gym, offered by Hugging Face, is a benchmark tool that evaluates AI agents based on uncertain requirements and complex constraints in real-world delivery processes. With 95 end-to-end tasks based on real project scenarios from eighteen different sectors, it aims to measure the performance of agents in live systems.

snapshot.description: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. items.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: ForcingBooster introduces a method that adapts computational power according to the complexity of image content in autoregressive video diffusion models. This approach aims to accelerate the video generation process by optimizing denoising operations in static or simple regions.

items.title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
items.summary: Data World, shared by Hugging Face, is a multi-agent engine developed to overcome environmental constraints and validation challenges in the training process of data agents. The system synthesizes analysis processes and tasks through mechanisms by defining the world underlying these files before creating them.

snapshot.description: Data agents use code to process heterogeneous files and derive analytical insights. Scaling their training faces costly environment curation, privacy and intellectual-property restrictions, and difficulty verifying open-ended findings without known generative truth. Our core insight is to specify the world behind the files before generating the files themselves. items.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
items.summary: OmniVerifier-C1, published on Hugging Face, is a model developed for the verification of complex visual content. Unlike traditional binary judgments, it acts as an AI visual verifier that offers more detailed and continuous scoring by breaking down complex rules.

snapshot.description: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique

items.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
items.summary: MAI-Gym is an open-source platform developed for the evaluation, data collection, and reinforcement learning training of graphical user interface (GUI) agents in mobile, computer, and web environments. It aims to solve challenges such as the cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic tasks by consolidating them through a common pipeline.

snapshot.description: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. A group of multiple AI agents that collaborate by communicating with each other to solve complex tasks.
A method that enables AI to provide more accurate information by scanning and using up-to-date external data while generating answers.
AI models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of a trained AI model generating predictions or results using new data provided to it.
A structured indexing system automatically created by the system to allow for rapid data retrieval.
